plan: <plan id="math-train/6817#0"><block units="1-2"><path units="1-1"><outline>Count vertex pairs by chord length and identify the diameter contribution.</outline></path><path units="2-2"><outline>Evaluate the needed trigonometric values for the chord sum.</outline></path><conclusion>Combine the pair counts with the trigonometric values to obtain the total distance.</conclusion></block></plan>
rationale: Подсчёт хорд и вычисление значений синусов разделены; третий юнит объединяет результаты.

plan: <plan id="math-train/6818#0"><block units="1-2"><path units="1-1"><outline>Pair the outer angles symmetrically about 111 degrees.</outline></path><path units="2-2"><outline>Pair the four remaining angles about the same central direction.</outline></path><conclusion>Add the positive pair magnitudes along the common direction.</conclusion></block></plan>
rationale: Две непересекающиеся группы углов разбираются независимо; третий юнит складывает векторы.

plan: <plan id="math-train/6840#0"><block units="1-2"><path units="1-1"><outline>Compute the tangent of 75 degrees from the angle sum formula.</outline></path><path units="2-2"><outline>Compute the cotangent of 75 degrees from the complementary angle.</outline></path><conclusion>Use both values in the symmetric cubic expression.</conclusion></block></plan>
rationale: Тангенс и котангенс получены разными формулами без зависимости между путями; третий юнит подставляет оба.

plan: <plan id="math-train/6864#0"><block units="1-2"><path units="1-1"><outline>Count the sine-square terms and their constant contribution.</outline></path><path units="2-2"><outline>Evaluate the cosine correction with roots of unity.</outline></path><conclusion>Subtract the cosine correction from the constant contribution.</conclusion></block></plan>
rationale: Постоянная часть и косинусная поправка вычислены отдельно; третий юнит объединяет их.

plan: <plan id="math-train/6868#0"></plan>
rationale: Второй фрагмент начинается с The other и ссылается на первый путь; сборщик отклоняет sibling_start. Текст источника не изменён.

plan: <plan id="math-train/3527#0"><block units="1-2"><path units="1-1"><outline>Express the product's numerator as factorials.</outline></path><path units="2-2"><outline>Express the squared denominator as factorials.</outline></path><conclusion>Divide the factorial products and cancel common factors.</conclusion></block></plan>
rationale: Числитель и знаменатель преобразованы независимо; третий юнит выполняет деление.

plan: <plan id="math-train/3509#0"><block units="1-2"><path units="1-1"><outline>Evaluate the objective at q equals zero.</outline></path><path units="2-2"><outline>Evaluate the objective at q equals one.</outline></path><conclusion>Take the larger endpoint value and minimize it over p.</conclusion></block></plan>
rationale: Значения функции на концах интервала q получены независимо; третий юнит ищет минимакс.

plan: <plan id="math-train/3511#0"><block units="1-2"><path units="1-1"><outline>Bound the coordinates and enumerate valid pairs with first coordinate one.</outline></path><path units="2-2"><outline>Enumerate valid pairs with first coordinate two or three.</outline></path><conclusion>Add the counts from all first-coordinate cases.</conclusion></block></plan>
rationale: Первый путь устанавливает общую область и считает случай a=1; второй считает непересекающиеся случаи a=2,3 по исходным неравенствам.

plan: <plan id="math-train/3518#0"><block units="1-2"><path units="1-1"><outline>Express the distance between the quadratic roots through the discriminant.</outline></path><path units="2-2"><outline>Express the sum of the squared roots through Vieta's formulas.</outline></path><conclusion>Equate these expressions and solve for the parameter.</conclusion></block></plan>
rationale: Разность корней и сумма квадратов выведены независимо; третий юнит приравнивает их.

plan: <plan id="math-train/3569#0"><block units="1-2"><path units="1-1"><outline>Find the first complex magnitude and the distance upper bound.</outline></path><path units="2-2"><outline>Find the second magnitude and construct opposite directions.</outline></path><conclusion>Apply the attained upper bound to the required distance.</conclusion></block></plan>
rationale: Граница и конструкция её достижения выделены раздельно; третий юнит соединяет результаты.

plan: <plan id="math-train/3600#0"><block units="1-2"><path units="1-1"><outline>Eliminate y and use Vieta's formula for the sum of x coordinates.</outline></path><path units="2-2"><outline>Eliminate x and use Vieta's formula for the sum of y coordinates.</outline></path><conclusion>Add the two coordinate sums for the common intersection set.</conclusion></block></plan>
rationale: Исключения x и y выполнены независимо; третий юнит складывает суммы координат.

plan: <plan id="gsm8k-train/1339#0"><block units="1-2"><path units="1-1"><outline>Compute the copper pipe cost.</outline></path><path units="2-2"><outline>Compute the plastic pipe cost.</outline></path><conclusion>Add the costs of both pipe types.</conclusion></block></plan>
rationale: Расходы на две трубы вычислены независимо; третий юнит складывает их.

plan: <plan id="gsm8k-train/1344#0"><block units="1-2"><path units="1-1"><outline>Compute annual earnings at the new job.</outline></path><path units="2-2"><outline>Compute annual earnings at the old job.</outline></path><conclusion>Subtract old annual earnings from new annual earnings.</conclusion></block></plan>

plan: <plan id="gsm8k-train/1358#0"><block units="1-2"><path units="1-1"><outline>Derive the steak guest count and its entree cost.</outline></path><path units="2-2"><outline>Derive the chicken guest count and its entree cost.</outline></path><conclusion>Add both entree costs for the full catering budget.</conclusion></block></plan>

plan: <plan id="gsm8k-train/1375#0"><block units="1-2"><path units="1-1"><outline>Compute net profit for piglets sold after twelve months.</outline></path><path units="2-2"><outline>Compute net profit for piglets sold after sixteen months.</outline></path><conclusion>Add profits from both sale groups.</conclusion></block></plan>

plan: <plan id="gsm8k-train/1379#0"><block units="1-2"><path units="1-1"><outline>Count first-spring kittens still at home after adoption and returns.</outline></path><path units="2-2"><outline>Count second-spring kittens still at home after adoption.</outline></path><conclusion>Add kittens from both springs and the breeding rabbits.</conclusion></block></plan>

plan: <plan id="gsm8k-train/1404#0"><block units="1-2"><path units="1-1"><outline>Count clawings by the wombats.</outline></path><path units="2-2"><outline>Count clawings by the rheas.</outline></path><conclusion>Add clawings from the two animal groups.</conclusion></block></plan>

plan: <plan id="gsm8k-train/1408#0"><block units="1-2"><path units="1-1"><outline>Compute mileage during the first half of the year.</outline></path><path units="2-2"><outline>Compute mileage during the second half of the year.</outline></path><conclusion>Add mileage from both halves of the year.</conclusion></block></plan>

plan: <plan id="gsm8k-train/1434#0"><block units="1-2"><path units="1-1"><outline>Count tennis balls used in the first two rounds.</outline></path><path units="2-2"><outline>Count tennis balls used in the third round and finals.</outline></path><conclusion>Add balls used in both tournament stages.</conclusion></block></plan>

rationale: Второй фрагмент начинается с The other half и ссылается на первый путь; сборщик отклоняет sibling_start. Текст источника не изменён.

plan: <plan id="gsm8k-train/1456#0"><block units="1-2"><path units="1-1"><outline>Count fish caught by Jackson and Jonah together.</outline></path><path units="2-2"><outline>Count fish caught by George.</outline></path><conclusion>Add the teammates' catches for the competition total.</conclusion></block></plan>

plan: <plan id="gsm8k-train/1498#0"><block units="1-2"><path units="1-1"><outline>Compute Kristy's base monthly salary from hours and hourly pay.</outline></path><path units="2-2"><outline>Compute Kristy's sales commission.</outline></path><conclusion>Add salary and commission, then allocate the insurance share.</conclusion></block></plan>

plan: <plan id="gsm8k-train/1508#0"><block units="1-2"><path units="1-1"><outline>Compute Jemma's frame sales revenue.</outline></path><path units="2-2"><outline>Compute Dorothy's frame sales revenue from her quantity and price.</outline></path><conclusion>Add the two frame sellers' revenues.</conclusion></block></plan>
rationale: Выручка каждой продавщицы вычислена отдельно; третий юнит складывает их.

plan: <plan id="gsm8k-train/1548#0"><block units="1-2"><path units="1-1"><outline>Count bugs left immediately after the spray.</outline></path><path units="2-2"><outline>Count bugs eaten by the introduced spiders.</outline></path><conclusion>Subtract the spiders' consumption from the post-spray count.</conclusion></block></plan>

plan: <plan id="gsm8k-train/1551#0"><block units="1-2"><path units="1-1"><outline>Count time-outs caused by running and throwing food.</outline></path><path units="2-2"><outline>Independently derive the time-outs caused by swearing from the stated rates.</outline></path><conclusion>Sum all time-outs and multiply by their duration.</conclusion></block></plan>

plan: <plan id="gsm8k-train/1558#0"><block units="1-2"><path units="1-1"><outline>Compute Janet's current monthly income.</outline></path><path units="2-2"><outline>Compute her freelance monthly income after added costs.</outline></path><conclusion>Subtract current income from freelance net income.</conclusion></block></plan>

plan: <plan id="gsm8k-train/1565#0"><block units="1-2"><path units="1-1"><outline>Count waiting time for base and clear coats.</outline></path><path units="2-2"><outline>Count waiting time for both color coats.</outline></path><conclusion>Add drying times across all four coats.</conclusion></block></plan>

plan: <plan id="gsm8k-train/1674#0"><block units="1-2"><path units="1-1"><outline>Compute John's silver purchase cost.</outline></path><path units="2-2"><outline>Compute John's gold purchase cost.</outline></path><conclusion>Add the silver and gold purchase costs.</conclusion></block></plan>
